localBiteReport: The early-fall transition is delivering one of the better inshore windows of the year around Choctawhatchee Bay and Destin, with water temps at 85°F. Redfish are the standout target right now — both slot-sized fish and larger bulls are accessible, with bigger reds holding near bridges where live croakers and spot minnows are the preferred bait. Flounder and speckled trout are also producing well, showing up mixed in with the redfish bite as bait has become much easier to locate in the mornings. Structure-oriented fishing near the Destin Bridge, Brooks Bridge, jetties, and deeper docks is especially productive at the moment, with tide movement being a key factor. Note: this summary is based on the most recently available report covering the week of September 18–24, 2026.
